what: Jabbit review: registered studies that measure bone on GLP-1 drugs or cagrilintide (ClinicalTrials.gov API v2) and a DailyMed scan of 9 US GLP-1 brand labels for fracture or bone-density text
method:
Hand-review layer over ops/data/glp1-bone/ctgov-raw.json (from glp1_bone_ctgov.py) plus a DailyMed label scan
(ops/data/glp1-bone/spl/*.xml). Every bone-flagged registry record was read by hand on 2026-10-20 (ET).
Kept = the study gives a GLP-1 drug (semaglutide, tirzepatide, liraglutide, exenatide, supaglutide, "GLP-1 RA" as a class)
or cagrilintide, AND registers a bone outcome (BMD, bone mineral content, bone turnover markers, trabecular bone score,
HR-pQCT/QCT, fracture) or names bone in its title. Writes site/research/sources/glp1-bone-ctgov-labels-2026-10-20.json. Jabbit analysis.
